title: César Jáuregui, Maru Campos’s Former Prosecutor, Arrested in Relation to the CIA Case in Chihuahua
author: Jesús Estrada
content:
_This article by[Jesús
Estrada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/autores/Jes%C3%BAs%20Estrada) originally
appeared in the [October 17, 2026 edition of La
Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/10/17/politica/detienen-a-
cesar-jauregi-ex-fiscal-de-maru-campos-relacionado-al-caso-cia-en-chihuahua),
Mexico's premier left wing daily newspaper._

**Chihuahua, Chihuahua**. The [Chihuahua Prosecutor's
Office](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/06/08/politica/policias-de-
chihuahua-armaron-al-agente-de-la-cia-y-esfumaron-el-rifle-tras-accidente)
this morning **arrested former prosecutor César Jáuregui Moreno** , and will
bring him before an initial hearing charged with the crime of unlawful
exercise of public service, allegedly related to the **participation of agents
of the[CIA in the
operation](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/05/19/columnas/en-
chihuahua-el-plan-de-trump-la-cia-y-su-accionar-ilegal-sabotear-gobiernos-su-
objetivo-ciudad-perdida)** to dismantle a narco lab in the community of El
Pinal.

Jáuregui's capture took place on Cantera Avenue in the city of Chihuahua, in
an operation by agents of the Public Prosecutor's Office and state police,
stemming from the arrest warrant against him, within criminal case 3055/2026.

The Prosecutor's Office obtained the arrest warrant yesterday, October 16,
before judges of the Morelos District of the Judiciary of the State of
Chihuahua.

The state Prosecutor's Office is also seeking the arrest of the former special
prosecutor for Strategic Operations and Anti-Kidnapping, **Guillermo Arturo
Zuany Portillo** , against whom an arrest warrant was issued for unlawful
exercise of public service, coalition, and false statements before
authorities, with an aggravated penalty.
